claim: Patchline ships a verifier-in-the-loop guarantee that no agent action merges without a passing certificate. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the passing certificate claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make verifier-in-the-loop-gate`.
